name: Condition grade
description: Overall condition: A (like new), B (excellent), C (very good), D (good/project).

name: Condition notes
description: Free-text description of cosmetic and functional condition.

name: CO₂ saved (kg)
description: Estimated CO₂e saved vs buying new.

name: MSRP when new
description: Retail price of the equivalent new product at time of original sale.

name: Repairability score
description: 0–10 score for spare parts availability and ease of self-repair.

name: Warranty (months)
description: Length of the refurbisher-provided warranty.

name: Warranty text
description: Short description shown on the warranty bar.

name: Battery health (%)
description: Electronics: remaining battery capacity as a percentage.

name: Battery cycle count
description: Electronics: number of recorded charge cycles.

name: Refurbished year
description: Year the current refurbishment was completed.

name: Digital Product Passport ID
description: Unique identifier for the DPP record (EU ESPR).

name: Digital Product Passport URL
description: Public URL of the DPP page / QR target.

name: Country of origin
description: ESPR country-of-origin declaration.

name: Materials
description: Dominant material composition (DPP).

name: Before image
description: Photo before refurbishment (before/after slider).

name: After image
description: Photo after refurbishment (before/after slider).

name: Serial hash
description: SHA-256 of the device serial (traceability).

name: Member price
description: Discounted price for tag-locked customers (loyalty / member tier).

name: B2B tiered pricing
description: JSON array of {min_qty, price_pct_off} tiers. e.g. [{"min_qty":5,"price_pct_off":10}].

name: Minimum order quantity
description: B2B minimum order quantity per variant.

name: Size chart HTML
description: Optional per-product size chart override (otherwise pulls from size-guide page).
